items.t: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in HP, Truist and PepsiCo Pays $65,144 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across HP, Truist Financial and PepsiCo pays about $65,100 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,430 a month. HP’s dividend looks the safest of the three, taking 28% of free cash flow over the trailing twelve months.

items.t: PepsiCo stands out in consumer staples as sector breaks three-year downtrend
items.sum: Investing.com -- Consumer staples had their best month since 2000 in October. Investors moved out of AI-related names, and the Nasdaq 100 lost 7% (After the AI Selloff, Wall Street Searches for Answers, Nov 4, 2026).
